skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Translate texts between Vietnamese and English, focusing on economic and business topics.
Analyze sentence structures and vocabulary in both source and target languages.
Identify and use appropriate technical terms in both languages.
Apply knowledge of economics, business management, marketing, human resources, finance, accounting, trade, and international economics.
Work independently and in groups to improve translation skills.
Demonstrate responsibility and ethical conduct in translation work.
Develop self-study habits and techniques for translation.
Analyze and solve translation problems using critical thinking.
Manage time effectively to meet translation deadlines.
Communicate effectively in class discussions and group activities.
